items.briefing:
A new study shows many Australian and New Zealand organisations are still paying ransomware attackers, which unfortunately encourages further attacks. Separately, Australia's superannuation sector is planning a cyber incident response exercise — a positive step given the sensitive financial data these funds hold. Microsoft has also released a major round of security updates this month, patching nearly 400 vulnerabilities, so ensuring your devices and software are updated promptly is important.

**Practical tip:** Check that your computer has installed the latest Microsoft updates — simply restart your device if updates are pending.

featured.title: Many ANZ ransomware victims still pay, study finds
featured.quote: Over a third of Australian ransomware victims still fail to recover data after paying, exposing critical incident response gaps.
